backend/main.mo: Motoko actor defining the backend for a Vedic services booking app, with types for service/booking/user data, a public `createBooking` function, and an admin-only `getAllBookings` query protected by an access control mixin.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping the admin panel feature (Internet Identity login, admin check, bookings dashboard) to its implementing frontend files and components with high confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-sentence summaries of all frontend source files, serving as a reference index for the project's frontend structure.
frontend/index.css: Base Tailwind CSS entry file defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens (background, foreground, primary, chart colors, sidebar, etc.).
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell for the React app titled 'Omm Vedic Numerology' that mounts the app into a `#root` div and loads the main TypeScript entry point.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that configures TanStack Router with two routes: `/` rendering HomePage and `/admin` rendering AdminPage.
frontend/src/components/admin/BookingsTa: Admin bookings display component rendering a responsive desktop table and mobile card layout with formatted service type, category, and status badge columns for all bookings.
frontend/src/components/booking/BookingF: Booking form component with dropdowns, text inputs, date picker, and validation that submits a new booking to the backend and shows a success confirmation screen with the returned booking ID.
frontend/src/components/home/AboutSectio: Static About section component with brand story text and a 2×2 grid of feature cards highlighting Ancient Wisdom, Personalized Guidance, Trusted Practice, and Holistic Approach.
frontend/src/components/home/HeroSection: Full-screen hero section for the Omm Vedic Numerology homepage featuring a background image, animated stars, Om symbol, tagline, and two CTA buttons (Book Now and Explore Services).
frontend/src/components/home/ServiceCard: Card component displaying a single service with its icon, name, descriptions, ₹400 price, and a Book Now button.
frontend/src/components/home/ServicesSec: Section component that renders a grid of ServiceCard components for all available services, with a header and a pricing note footer.
frontend/src/components/layout/Header.ts: Fixed top navigation header with logo, desktop nav links, a Book Now CTA, a hidden admin icon link, and a collapsible mobile menu.
frontend/src/data/services.ts: Defines the ServiceData interface and exports an array of four services (Tarot, Numerology, Vastu, Pronology), each priced at ₹400 with metadata and icon paths.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, supporting both anonymous and authenticated (Internet Identity) usage with admin token initialization.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminQueries.ts: Provides two React Query hooks: useIsCallerAdmin to check admin status and useGetAllBookings to fetch all bookings, both gated on authentication and admin access.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity authentication context and provider using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login, logout, identity, and status state to child components.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Exports a useCreateBooking mutation hook that submits a new booking to the backend actor and invalidates the bookings query cache on success.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that imports Google Fonts (Cinzel, Cormorant Garamond, Inter), sets up Tailwind directives, and defines a cosmic dark theme with gold accent CSS custom properties and utility classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that wraps the App component with TanStack QueryClientProvider and a custom InternetIdentityProvider before mounting to the DOM.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard page that handles Internet Identity login/logout, checks if the caller is an admin, and displays all bookings in a table with refresh capability.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Main public-facing page that composes Hero, Services, About, and Booking Form sections with smooth scroll navigation and a footer with social links.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module providing functions to read, persist, and clear URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage fallback support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the theme with custom fonts (Cinzel, Cormorant, Inter), oklch-based color tokens for gold and cosmic palettes, custom shadows, and keyframe animations.
project_state.json: Tracks the project state for 'Omm Vedic Numerology' website, including version, architectural notes, existing features, and requirements for a promotional site with booking and admin panel functionality.
